title: Prime Intellect Buys Moondream to Speed Up AI Inference
summary:
A startup with fewer than 10 employees is being integrated into Prime Intellect's computing stack to support the development of robotics and AI agents. The acquisition of Moondream enables Prime Intellect to train and deploy multimodal models across vision, video, voice, and decision models, as well as tools for computer use.

The purchase leverages Moondream's expertise in speeding up AI inference to lower overall computing costs for the company. These optimizations are intended to attract a customer base building autonomous applications that require highly efficient, open vision models for real-time deployment.
